title: Crypto-Cash Back: Understanding Crypto Reward Conversion Rates
summary: This document explains Crypto-Cash Back rewards and how they convert to crypto: earn 2.0% on eligible purchases, then pay a 1.25% conversion fee when redeeming to crypto. It provides the net payout formula (net = available rewards × (1 − 1.25%)) and notes the fiat amount is exchanged at the real-time market rate into the selected cryptocurrency.
